targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN state IN ('halted','killed') AND (halted_until IS NULL OR halted_until > now()) THEN 'HALTED' ELSE 'running' END AS state FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id='copy_promobuy'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy'
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy'

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_promobuy' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

panels.title: Cumulative realized PnL by track (incl. open partials)

targets.rawSql: WITH pe AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NULL THEN 'n' ELSE 'h' END) trk, (e->>'executed_at')::timestamptz ts, ((e->>'received_usdc')::numeric - t.size_usd*(e->>'fraction')::numeric) delta FROM trades t, json_array_elements(t.sim_metadata->'partial_exits') e WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' AND e->>'status'='filled' AND e->>'executed_at' IS NOT NULL), finals AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN t.sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NULL THEN 'n' ELSE 'h' END) trk, t.exit_at ts, (t.pnl_usd - COALESCE((SELECT SUM((e->>'received_usdc')::numeric - t.size_usd*(e->>'fraction')::numeric) FROM json_array_elements(t.sim_metadata->'partial_exits') e WHERE e->>'status'='filled'),0)) delta FROM trades t WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.exit_at IS NOT NULL), ev AS (SELECT * FROM pe UNION ALL SELECT * FROM finals) SELECT ts AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN trk='n' THEN delta ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS "null-liq (small)", SUM(CASE WHEN trk='h' THEN delta ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS "has-liq (full)" FROM ev ORDER BY ts
SELECT exit_at AS time, pnl_pct AS value FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' ORDER BY exit_at

SELECT sf.features_json->>'source' AS source, ROUND(SUM(t.pnl_usd)::numeric, 2) AS net_pnl, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trades t JOIN signal_features sf ON sf.trade_id=t.id WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.fill_status='closed' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' AND sf.features_json->>'source' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_pnl DESC

WITH liq AS (SELECT (sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::float AS l FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' AND sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN l < 50000 THEN '<50k' WHEN l < 100000 THEN '50-100k' WHEN l < 250000 THEN '100-250k' WHEN l < 1000000 THEN '250k-1M' ELSE '1M+' END AS bucket, MIN(l) AS sort_key, COUNT(*) AS count FROM liq GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sort_key

SELECT id, asset, CASE WHEN sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NULL THEN 'null-liq (small)' ELSE 'has-liq (full)' END AS track, entry_price, size_usd, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric, 1) AS peak_pct, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric, 0) AS entry_liq, entry_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' ORDER BY entry_at DESC

SELECT id, asset, CASE WHEN sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NULL THEN 'null-liq (small)' ELSE 'has-liq (full)' END AS track, entry_price, exit_price, size_usd, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric, 1) AS peak_pct, ROUND(pnl_pct::numeric, 2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(pnl_usd::numeric, 2) AS pnl_usd, exit_reason, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric, 0) AS entry_liq, entry_at, exit_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' ORDER BY exit_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
SELECT halted_at, halt_type, severity, LEFT(reason, 100) AS reason, resumed_at, resumed_by FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_promobuy' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sf.features_json->>'source')::text AS sources FROM trades t JOIN signal_features sf ON sf.trade_id=t.id WHERE t.bot_id='copy' AND t.mode='paper' AND t.sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy' AND sf.features_json->>'source' IS NOT NULL

WITH r AS (SELECT (CASE WHEN sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd' IS NULL THEN 'null-liq (small)' ELSE 'has-liq (full)' END) AS track, fill_status, pnl_usd, size_usd, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM((e->>'received_usdc')::numeric - size_usd*(e->>'fraction')::numeric),0) FROM json_array_elements(sim_metadata->'partial_exits') e WHERE e->>'status'='filled') AS open_part FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='promobuy') SELECT track, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='closed') AS closed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='open') AS riding, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='closed' AND pnl_usd>0) AS wins, ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='closed' AND pnl_usd>0)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='closed'),0) * 100)::numeric,1) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(pnl_usd) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='closed'),0) + COALESCE(SUM(open_part) FILTER (WHERE fill_status='open'),0))::numeric,2) AS net_realized_usd, ROUND(SUM(size_usd)::numeric,0) AS capital_usd FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
